description:
Clear Your Head Music | Slow Sarod | Indian Classical

You woke up but your head didn't. There's a fog over everything — yesterday's leftovers, half-formed worries, noise with no shape. You can't think straight yet.

This is the music for that exact moment. Not to relax you back toward sleep, not to soothe anxiety — just to clear the fog and give your mind a clean place to start the day from.

This is 90 minutes of slow Sarod in Raga Ahir Bhairav — a serene, devotional morning raga. The Sarod is fretless and resonant; its plucked notes slide and bloom and then settle, like the fog lifting off the mind one phrase at a time. A light tabla keeps a quiet forward pulse underneath, so the music moves you gently toward the day instead of holding you still.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Sarod — fretless plucked strings, deep resonant sustain and long meend slides
- Raga Ahir Bhairav — a serene, devotional morning raga (flat Re and flat Ni)
- Light, low tabla — a quiet forward pulse, never busy
- A clean, unhurried morning texture — clarity, not energy
- 90 unbroken minutes at 432Hz tuning

⏱ Chapters
0:00    The fog — settling in
20:00   Clearing
45:00   Open and clear
70:00   Steady morning focus
85:00   Gentle close

🧠 How to use:
Press play before you decide anything. Let the Sarod do the clearing — drink your water, sit for a minute, let the first thoughts arrive on their own. Keep it on through your first task and let the light pulse carry you into the day.

⏱ Best for:
• Clearing a foggy head first thing in the morning
• Thinking clearly before the day starts
• Morning deep work and focused tasks
• A calm, clean start without alarm-clock urgency
• Journaling or planning the day

production_spec.notes: Raga Ahir Bhairav — a serene, devotional morning raga. Sa Re(komal) Ga Ma Pa Dha Ni(komal) Sa. The komal Re (flat 2nd) gives the grave devotional opening of the Bhairav family, while the natural Ga/Dha and komal Ni (flat 7th) lift it into a softer, sweeter, fresher morning ascending quality than pure Bhairav — serene rather than severe, which fits a clean clear-headed morning start without anxiety or energy. SAROD is plucked (fretless metal fingerboard, coconut-shell plectrum) so light tabla is OK and welcome here — it gives a quiet forward morning momentum that suits the cognitive 'move into the day' intent. Keep tabla LOW and supportive, never busy or featured. Alpha 10Hz binaural — relaxed alertness, present and awake (not Theta/Delta). LUFS -14 (morning awake viewer). EMOTIONAL TAG ROTATION: clip 1: 'like the morning fog lifting off the mind, leaving a clean place to begin' · clip 2: 'each plucked note blooms then settles — the head clearing one phrase at a time' · clip 3: 'clear morning light filling a quiet room, unhurried and unclouded'. 90min = 3-4 Suno clips + loop extension.
